description.en: The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, one-click install · DSH 可视化插件市场
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场，让你轻松浏览、搜索并一键安装各类插件，扩展 DeepSeek Harness 功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.
Command Code for DSH｜订阅接入：将 Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持模型同步、推理预设、用量提醒和联网搜索。
description.zh: Command Code for DSH｜订阅接入：通过 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置接入 Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅，支持模型同步预览、收藏与隐藏、逐模型推理预设、主动调用诊断、用量提醒、配置导入导出和联网搜索。

description.en: 让你可以从侧边栏拖拽会话，使其成为一个独立窗口，省得来回切换会话的插件！
Message edit / regenerate plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web — Cordis host plugin (/api/msg-edit/*) + dsh.client UI plugin (assistant action strip). Declarative bundle, no install scripts.
YesPlayMusic controls and now-playing status for dsh-TUI
Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.
DSH web plugin: searchable model selector for DeepSeek Harness WebUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 加个能实时搜索的模型选择器，找模型不用再翻半天。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: historical token and money aggregates folded from every durable session log, drawn as a rolling-year heatmap.

Third-party provider reasoning-effort AND input-modality settings for DeepSeek Harness: thinking levels and image-input support declared per model, auto-adapted from a model knowledge base + wire-protocol inference, edited right inside the official Models
A6API 多模型聚合站接入插件：原生 LLM 提供商注册、账户实时余额与价格波动监控、Token 白名单同步、商户线路探测与全景指标卡片
Telegram channel for DeepSeek Harness — real Telegram markdown, and answer the agent's questions and approvals straight from chat
Floating DeepSeek API balance badge for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, backed by the harness's own DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential
A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers. Fork adds answer message bubbles with a settings switch.
邮件待办：读取 dsh-email 的邮件内容，用 LLM 把邮件里的工作事项提取成可管理的待办清单，并在 Web 客户端右侧 Sidebar 提供一个「待办」tab。
AI Services: shared model routing, bounded auxiliary calls, and usage receipts for other plugins.

macOS-native theme for DeepSeek Harness: a floating translucent workbench window on a sky-blue gradient desktop, with the macOS light and dark palettes. Pure UI plugin — the browser half stacks a token override layer on the active theme and injects the st

Agentic browser plumbing for DeepSeek Harness: the host ctx.browser service (stealth launch, CDP-attach, and a relay + companion Chrome extension driving the user's own tabs) backing the browser tool in @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-browser — no harness changes.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手接上真实浏览器，能隐身启动、接管你自己的标签页，让模型直接上网操作。

description.en: ChatCode CLI Plugin Market — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · ChatCode CLI 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。
TokenLab provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness with native Responses, Messages and Chat routing plus multimodal and async tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 TokenLab 模型通道，支持多模态工具和异步任务，装完就能用。

description.en: Happy Reader（dsh-happy-reader）—— DeepSeek Harness 桌面端阅读增强插件：隐藏输入框/上边栏、自由调整字号、中英分设正文字体、内容宽度扩展、一键全屏。dsh plugin / DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面调成适合长时间阅读的样子，隐藏输入框、调字号字体、一键全屏。

description.en: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).
description.zh: 受 A2UI 启发的模型生成应用卡片，提供持久机器目录、SSH 探测及经审阅授权的监控与控制操作。SSH 探测需 OpenSSH（ssh、ssh-keyscan、ssh-keygen）。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar account label (the phone number, email, or account name) and avatar with your own text and image, chosen in one dialog opened from a new row in the account menu, so screenshots do not expose the original.
description.zh: 把左下角账号处的文字（手机号/邮箱/账户名）和头像替换为你自定义的内容，编辑入口在账号菜单里，避免截图泄露隐私。

description.en: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加一个「团队」面板，列出每个 Agent Teams 会话的成员与任务路线图、按时间段统计的 token 消耗与美元/卢布成本、总工时与在线时长，并可归档旧团队。需先安装 Agent Teams 插件。

description.en: Five production-grade DSH tools bundled into one plugin (8 tool slots total): git regression finder (find introducer, recent changes, bisect, blame age), stack-trace decoder with local code context, YAML/ENV/properties config validator with typo suggestions, cross-platform shell escape (POSIX/PowerShell/cmd), and MyBatis Plus SQL static auditor (N+1, missing @Transactional, LIKE leading %, SELECT *, missing WHERE). Zero npm dependencies, all offline and concurrency-safe.
description.zh: 五个生产级 DSH 工具合一的 bundle（共 8 个 tool slot）：git 回归定位（引入者反查、最近改动、二分定位、blame 年龄）、带本地代码上下文的堆栈解码器、YAML/ENV/properties 配置校验器（带近似键名提示）、跨平台 shell 转义（POSIX/PowerShell/cmd）、MyBatis Plus SQL 静态审计器（N+1、缺 @Transactional、LIKE 前导 %、SELECT *、缺 WHERE）。零 npm 依赖，全离线、并发安全。

description.en: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.
description.zh: 每日 AI 三报：抓取 10 个信源（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Hugging Face、arXiv、Hacker News 等），语义聚类去重，程序打分加 LLM 打分，每天定时把选出的三条发到邮箱，并附「事实／为什么重要／影响／存疑」四段解读；另提供 4 个对话工具与侧边栏面板，用于预览、立即发送和改配置。

description.en: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).
description.zh: 仅 Windows：在「设置 → 通用」增加一个开关，本次对话完成后按设定延迟（默认 60 秒，可设 5–86400 秒）自动关机，并弹出原生倒计时窗口，点一下即执行 shutdown /a 取消本次关机。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.
description.zh: 超大会话分块压缩：仅在实测上下文超过模型窗口 85%（或请求超过 4 MB）时接管，把历史按 1.5 MB 分块摘要再合并；小会话仍走 dsh 自带压缩。

description.en: Extract Bilibili platform/AI subtitles or external/embedded/ASR/OCR fallback and render Markdown, Word, PDF, TXT, SRT or JSON with timestamps, bilingual alignment and a quality report. Requires Python 3.10+; platform/AI subtitles need a Bilibili SESSDATA cookie; OCR/ASR/PDF need ffmpeg, faster-whisper and LibreOffice or reportlab.
description.zh: 从 Bilibili 视频或本地视频提取字幕，输出 Markdown、Word、PDF、TXT、SRT 或 JSON，支持时间戳、双语对齐和质量报告。需 Python 3.10+；平台/AI 字幕需 Bilibili SESSDATA Cookie；OCR/ASR/PDF 需 ffmpeg、faster-whisper，以及 LibreOffice 或 reportlab。

description.en: Gives the agent a real headed Chromium under the harness home, with browser_open and browser_interact tools that keep page state across calls.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，提供 browser_open 与 browser_interact 工具，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
description.zh: 把本机 cc-switch 里保存的第三方供应商接入 DeepSeek Harness：Anthropic 格式的工具分组注册为适配器路由，Codex 分组交给内置 pi-ai 适配器，并在设置页选择导入哪些分组以及它们的顺序。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.
description.zh: 聊天壁纸：用本地图片、本地视频或六套预设渐变做聊天背景，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、暗色遮罩、显示方式、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存在浏览器 IndexedDB，不上传。

description.en: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏增强：右键 tab 菜单增加「关闭其他标签」，一键关闭当前会话中除当前 tab 与引导页外的所有内容标签。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框提示词增强：✨ 按钮先判断歧义、再原地改写草稿；空草稿时以灰色 ghost 给出下一步建议，Tab 或点击填入草稿且不自动发送。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 连接 DSH 与本地 Qoder 桌面客户端登录态，接入 Qoder CN 官方模型（qmodel、qfmodel）。仅 Windows：凭据读取依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

description.en: Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.
description.zh: 原生多平台账号与模型路由管理，支持错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测。后台 worker 需独立 Node ≥22.23.3（node:sqlite，已由 engines.node 约束）；千问办公的编码能力另需 Python（cryptography、wasmtime）。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, and a cross-session canary alarm.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原，以及蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警。

description.en: Hover to reveal and leave to hide the left sidebar on Windows desktop and Web, with manual pinning, configurable delays and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: Windows 桌面版与 Web 左侧栏悬停展开、移开收起，支持手动固定、自定义延迟和减少动态效果。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Renders model answers as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness chat, with 24 whitelisted components and persistent turn cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的回答渲染成可交互卡片，内置 24 个白名单组件和回合尾部持久卡片。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：五个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.
description.zh: dsh 的按需 MCP 网关：每个 server 首次使用时才连接、空闲后自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，可导入现有的 mcpServers 配置，并对子进程环境变量做脱敏。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
description.zh: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

description.en: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.
description.zh: 用户消息原位编辑与重发插件：在已发送消息气泡下方复制按钮旁提供铅笔编辑图标，点击原位展开圆角内联编辑框，支持从上一轮末尾分叉回退重发或在当前会话直接追发。

description.en: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.
description.zh: DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调百万上下文、调最大输出、勾多模态发图（\[text, image]）、配思考强度档位（{low, high, max}）的繁琐痛点，支持设置页添加模型保存后自动补齐与可视化一键补齐。

description.en: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册两个工具：`doc_ocr` 把扫描件 PDF 与图片转成结构化文本（逐页文本、带资产负债表平衡勾稽的财务报表行、合同条款命中），可用本机 RapidOCR 或智谱 GLM-OCR 云端引擎；`doc_preprocess` 用 7 阶段管线把一批原始文件整理成 Obsidian 可读知识库，含后端路由与 sha256 增量跳过。勾稽不平的数字只报出、不编造。本机引擎需 Python 3 并安装 rapidocr-onnxruntime、pypdfium2、Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt）；GLM 引擎需设置 ZHIPU_API_KEY。

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

description.en: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.
description.zh: 把 opengis-skills 的 32 个 gis/ 技能（GDAL、QGIS、GeoServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、GeoPandas、Shapely、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、deck.gl 等）打包进 DSH 技能目录；目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考文档按需加载。

description.en: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.
description.zh: 磁盘审查盘面：Agent 写语义、你做决定，清理前预览、执行后可撤销。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 界面上的透明性能悬浮窗：三行小字直接浮在界面上显示 CPU、GPU、内存占用率，没有底色也没有边框，可拖动并吸附到最近的窗口角，最大化或改变窗口大小都不会跑位；CPU 封装温度由可选的高权限助手（LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO）读取，插件自身开销不到单核百分之一。仅 Windows。

description.en: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
description.zh: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

description.en: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

description.en: The star button in the composer enhances the draft with the session model and toggles back to the original text; the enhancement template files are editable.
description.zh: 发送框的星形按钮用当前会话模型增强提示词，并可切回原文；增强模板文件可编辑。

description.en: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 启动前与运行时的 HTTP 代理控制：把代理写入 DSH 用户级 .env，让启动器和任何插件加载前的请求也走代理，并在「插件」页用开关同步该文件。

description.en: Quarto book writing and theme skills, with check scripts for chapter structure and Chinese prose. Requires the Quarto CLI and Python 3 for the check scripts.
description.zh: Quarto 书稿写作与主题技能，附带章节结构与中文行文的检查脚本。检查脚本需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏或通过 rea_mcp_toggle 工具开关 rea-mcp 服务器：不用逆向时，170 个 mcp__rea__* 工具 schema 不再随每次请求发送（tools payload 由约 722 KB 降到约 95 KB），REA 子进程同时退出；选择存入 profile 级状态文件，重启后由行级 disabled 表达式恢复。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的 SAO 风格全屏启动动画。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: Runs a prompt on a cron-like interval; every run opens a fresh session and the run history is kept.
description.zh: 按周期定时执行提示词，每次触发都开启全新会话，并保留运行记录。

description.en: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.
description.zh: 输入框里的原生秒开截屏按钮：点一下冻结全屏，微信风格选区浮层（灰色遮罩、绿色边框），确认后截图自动插入当前会话草稿。相机旁的小眼睛可选「先隐藏整个 DSH 窗口再截屏」，截完自动恢复。不调用系统截图浮层，拖动约 10ms/帧，与语音输入并排共存。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；首次截屏会用系统自带的 .NET Framework csc.exe 编译辅助程序。

description.en: Adds a Skills page for browsing, toggling and editing the user skill root, plus a save_skill tool so the agent can author skills itself.
description.zh: 技能管理页可浏览、开关、编辑用户技能目录，并提供 save_skill 工具让 Agent 自行编写技能。

description.en: Counts agent steps and, every N of them, adds a progress-report instruction to the batch that is about to be sent, so the agent states what it is doing, what it finished and what comes next, then carries on without stopping for you. Interval, prompt text and a main-agent-only default are editable in its settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 步骤计数，每满 N 步就在即将发出的那一批消息里追加一条汇报指令，让 agent 说明正在做什么、已完成什么、接下来做什么，说完继续，不停下来等你确认。间隔、提示词原文、以及「只在主智能体汇报」的默认值都能在设置页里改。

description.en: Registers local Qoder and QoderCN subscription CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and /qoder and /qodercn commands.
description.zh: 把本机 Qoder 与 QoderCN 订阅 CLI 注册为 DSH 子代理后端，支持实时进度、单次额度显示、设置页以及 /qoder、/qodercn 斜杠指令。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: Algorithm field guide for graphics, animation, physics and AI work — 219 entries with tradeoffs and links to existing implementations, exposed as 10 agent tools and a sidebar page. AI-assisted tools require DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 图形/动画/物理/AI 算法的可查询天书——219 条术法，带取舍说明与现成实现链接，提供 10 个 agent 工具与侧栏页面。AI 工具需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

description.en: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.
description.zh: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：被 Android 杀掉后约 2 分钟内由 dsh 进程内看门狗复活，守护进程持续不在时由 dsh 自己兜底清理；设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理或演练。清理工具随包自带（bin/tmp-clean，Python 3），装好即用。

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带 npm 依赖，未装兄弟插件也能工作，缺失的通道仅显示未安装。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.
description.zh: Ctrl+滚轮整页缩放（60%–180%，记住比例），右下角常驻「设置」入口可打开宿主设置面板，Ctrl+0 复位。

description.en: Registers Epic's Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, create-toolset, unreal-skill), injects Unreal project context, and connects the editor's ModelContextProtocol server with a port form on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 注册 Epic 的 Unreal Engine 三个技能（unreal-mcp、create-toolset、unreal-skill），注入 UE 工程上下文，接通编辑器的 ModelContextProtocol 服务器，并支持在插件页修改端口。

description.en: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话用量面板：常驻用量圆环 + 可拖动面板，从本地会话日志聚合 token 用量、缓存命中率、成本与余额，支持工具级成本归因、iOS 式磁贴布局编辑与可选表情伴侣；数据只在本机读取，不联网。

description.en: Registers one `valuation_service` tool that reads a workpaper tree of 01/02/04 JSON and returns one unified schema: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots with explicit missing markers, comparable PS/PE and IRR. Deterministic and local: missing WACC, growth, capex, D&A or working-capital inputs stay blank instead of being guessed, and assumption differences are flagged for review.
description.zh: 注册一个 `valuation_service` 工具：读取 01/02/04 JSON 底稿树，输出统一 schema——六大类比率、预测比率、带 missing 标记的 DCF 输入槽、可比 PS/PE 与 IRR。确定性、本机运行：缺 WACC/增长率/资本开支/折旧摊销/营运资本时留空而不猜测，假设差异逐项标出交人工复核。

description.en: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供的图像识别转发：后台调用你配置的 GLM 兼容视觉接口分析图片，原模型在同一会话继续作答，你的消息、图片、模型与历史全程不变。需先运行仓库自带的 patches/apply-core-patch.cmd 给 DSH 打核心补丁，否则带图消息会在入库前被原版 DSH 拒绝（可用 restore 脚本还原）。

description.en: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.
description.zh: 同时兼容 DSH 与 Pi 的搜索与抓取提供方：Exa、Tavily、Parallel、Firecrawl、TinyFish 匿名优先路由，计费需显式授权，带额度预检与有界取消。

description.en: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
description.zh: 為網頁介面加入繁體中文（zh-Hant）語言，經語言服務註冊，每個 namespace 各有一份字典，並可在「設定 → 一般 → 語言」揀選。

description.en: Windows-only game crash diagnosis from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps, with a diagnose_game_crash tool and an optional background notifier.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows：从事件日志、WER 报告和崩溃转储诊断游戏崩溃，提供 diagnose_game_crash 工具和可选的后台通知。

description.en: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
description.zh: 将 Liquid Inference 拍卖式推理交易所接入为模型路由，提供 liquid.auto 及其排序变体，并附带四个工具，用于读取报价、市场、路由器与任务收据。需 Liquid Inference API Key（LIQUID_API_KEY，spend 权限）。

description.en: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.
description.zh: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板：按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总；含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出与缓存读写明细、轮次/步骤、平均 tok/s，归档后仍保留历史。

description.en: Move45clock: a health clock for DeepSeek Harness. A 45-minute work timer (5–120 minutes), 12 guided 12–15 minute seated/standing break plans, a visual plan editor, reminder cards scalable to 200%, night reminders at 21:30/22:00/22:30, and optional action-name voice coaching. Window wake is Windows-only.
description.zh: Move45clock · 健康钟：每工作 45 分钟弹出引导式休息卡片，内置 12 套 12～15 分钟坐/站计划；支持可视化编辑计划、弹窗放大、21:30/22:00/22:30 夜间提醒，以及可选的动作名语音播报；Windows 下可把托盘窗口叫回前台。

description.en: Arknights PRTS Originium Protocol theme featuring interactive 3D crystal, tactical HUD, memory fragments, and boot sequence.
description.zh: 明日方舟 PRTS 源石协议主题：可交互旋转 3D 源石晶簇、工业指令面板、普瑞赛斯记忆残片与启动序列。

description.en: WeChat personal assistant that manages Apple Calendar and Reminders with confirmation before writes and sends scheduled WeChat messages, for macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 通过微信管理 Apple 日历与提醒事项，写入前展示预览并确认，支持微信定时消息；适用于 macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac。

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

description.en: Use your Kimi Code / Grok (X Premium) / Google Antigravity / GLM (BigModel) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers - OAuth sign-in, per-model visibility, drag-to-reorder Auto fallback, and plan quotas from the Settings page. No API keys.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Antigravity、GLM 的订阅账号接进 DSH 当模型用，扫码登录还能拖动排序自动切换。

description.en: Infix rerun for DeepSeek Harness: re-run any earlier turn in place - the reply is regenerated from the same prompt while every later turn survives, so subsequent calls read A B C1 D E F G. Official seams only; the append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: 点一下就能重跑之前某一轮回答，后面的对话还都保留，历史不乱。

description.en: Read the agent's newest reply aloud and control volume from the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在输入框一键朗读最新回复，按住上拖还能调音量，不用离开打字位置。
